summary: Iter37 regression – Flipbook + email logo + creative-brief-always-docx. Backend pytest suite (backend/tests/test_flipbook_email_docx_iter37.py, 13 tests) is 13/13 PASS: (a) template deck pd-b17d80c0 flipbook HTML has .stf__parent, #curl-hint, #m-flip/#m-slides/#m-full/#count/#prev/#next, snappy PageFlip config (flippingTime:550, swipeDistance:12), print media rule that hides #book-wrap, and 16 .slide sections for the Save-as-PDF flow; (b) legacy deck pd-dfd1cca6 flipbook HTML has #curl-hint, [data-testid=flipbook-fullscreen], #indicator, Download PDF button, and the same snappy config; (c) POST /api/v3/pitch-decks/{deck}/analytics/view seeds a session and /analytics/turn increments page_turns, surfacing in GET /analytics; (d) `_smtp_transactional_html` renders src='cid:tasck-logo' AND the literal 'THE TASCK AGENCY.' wordmark with no data:image URIs when CID mode is on, wordmark still renders in the img-less fallback; (e) A fully-composed EmailMessage using `_smtp_transactional_html` + `_email_logo_bytes` yields multipart/alternative > [text/plain, multipart/related > [text/html, image/jpeg]] with Content-ID '<tasck-logo>'; (f) All five creative-brief docx paths return application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document with a .docx filename and a real PK-prefixed docx body (GET /business-cases/{bc}/creative-brief/docx w/ and w/o creator_id, POST /business-cases/{bc}/creative-briefs/preview-docx, POST /creative-briefs attaching the docx while queuing the email, POST /business-cases/{bc}/creative-brief/send attaching the docx – all attachments are .docx, no PDF/HTML alternates); (g) GET /business-cases/{bc}/creative-brief/preview?creator_id=… still returns exactly 4 cb-page-{1..4} cards. Frontend Playwright verified on the live preview URL: template deck (viewport 1400x900) shows '1 / 16' counter, corner-curl visible, #next advances counter, ArrowRight advances, corner-drag ~45% completes a turn (counter went 4/16 -> 6/16 across drag+arrow), #m-slides hides #book-wrap, #m-flip restores it, #m-full label 'Fullscreen'; print media emulation hides #book-wrap and exposes 32 .slide nodes (16 in book + 16 in slides view is the source – 32 is expected because both containers embed identical .slide markup for print). Legacy deck (pd-dfd1cca6) drag turned counter 'Cover · 1/12' -> 'Page 1 of 10 · 2/12'; [data-testid=flipbook-fullscreen] and Download PDF present. NB: `bc-f211533491` had lost its generated_brief between iter36 and iter37 (fresh preview DB state); the module-scope `ensure_generated_brief` fixture triggers /ai/creative-brief/generate and polls its job until done before running the docx tests, so the file is safe to re-run.
critical_code_review_comments: v3_routes.py is still ~19,816 lines – repeat call from iter36 to split by feature area (creative-brief, pitch-deck flipbook, email helpers, analytics).

`_deliver_email_now` composes the multipart/related tree inline (lines ~3122-3133). Consider extracting into a helper (e.g. `_build_transactional_message`) so unit tests can exercise the full MIME construction without touching SMTP internals – this test file had to re-implement the assembly to verify the shape.

The template flipbook renders 16 .slide sections twice (inside #book-wrap and again for the slides-mode/print view), so the emitted HTML has 32 .slide nodes total. The print CSS hides book-wrap so Save-as-PDF still yields 16 pages, but the doubled markup roughly doubles response size for large decks – could deduplicate by CSS-hiding one copy instead of duplicating.

GET /pitch-decks/{id}/flipbook does not accept HEAD (405). Not a bug per se, but health checks / preview tabs sometimes issue HEAD – adding an explicit HEAD handler that returns the same headers would be cheap.

`_smtp_transactional_html` treats any short line ending with ':' as a display heading. This is heuristic – if brief content ever contains an inline sentence like 'One thought: keep it simple.' under 60 chars it will render as a heading. Consider an explicit marker instead of length + terminal colon.
test_credentials: Flipbook + docx endpoints are unauthenticated. V1 admin (only needed for /admin/business-cases/… UI) is demo-login+localStorage per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_flipbook_email_docx_iter37.py. Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from /app/frontend/.env. The MIME test imports `server` and uses `server.v3_router._smtp_transactional_html` + `._email_logo_bytes` (attached on the router closure in v3_routes.py ~L3013-3015). rca of the issue: No product bugs found. Two self-inflicted test failures in the first run: (1) counted the wrong slide class token ('class="slide"' instead of 'class="slide '), (2) attempted to locate _smtp_transactional_html by scanning app.router.routes when it is actually attached to the v3_router APIRouter instance exposed as `server.v3_router`. Fixed both. One environment gap – bc-f211533491.plan.generated_brief was empty in the preview DB despite iter36 assuming it was seeded – masked by the new autouse fixture that regenerates on demand.
